sq-mixkit-52106-front.how: Bottoms read from a 2 fps contact sheet. Goblet squats, thighs about level, knees over the feet: good form.

sq-mixkit-52117-45.how: 4 fps sheet. Two good squats; from 5.4 s the person steps back into a lunge, which is not a squat and should not be counted.

sq-mixkit-52116-front-low.how: 4 fps sheet. One full squat; a second one begins as the clip ends. Camera low, looking up.

sq-mixkit-752-45.how: 2 fps sheet. Wall-ball squats with the ball overhead at the top; the camera is about 45 degrees off the front, not from the side. The clip opens at the bottom of a squat: the coach waits for the start position, so that half repetition is not labelled.

sq-cdc-half-45.how: 1 fps sheet and the source's own title: a deliberate HALF squat (thighs well above level), so for a full squat the depth is wrong on purpose. Real wrong-depth evidence. The third squat of the first shot and the one of the second shot are cut before they end.

sq-tf-goblet-front.how: 1.7 fps sheet. Kettlebell goblet squats on a beach, facing the camera, bright sun. Two full squats with long pauses standing: good form.

sq-tf-frontraise-side.how: 2 fps sheet. Kettlebell squats with a front raise at the bottom, from the side, deep: good form. At 9.5-10.5 s he bends forward to swing the kettlebell (a hinge, not a squat): it must not be counted.

pu-mixkit-50762-side.how: 2 fps sheet. Four push-ups filmed about 50 degrees off the side (closer to the front): outside the push-up's camera setup, so the guide asks to turn and nothing is counted, on purpose.

pu-cdc-knee-45.how: 2.5 fps sheet. Knee push-ups, camera about 20-35 degrees off the side. The hips look slightly bent; by eye we cannot say whether that is a fault, so the body-line rule is not judged on this clip (neither a false alarm nor a catch).

pu-cdc-full-45.how: 2.5 fps sheet. The clip ends at the bottom of its only push-up: nothing complete to count.

pu-interval-side.how: 2.5 fps sheet. Slow push-ups with a hold at the bottom, backlit silhouette from the side; straight body line: good form.

pu-mixkit-731-front.how: Push-ups filmed from the front at floor level: the body line cannot be seen, the guide asks to turn, nothing is counted, on purpose.

pu-mixkit-50761-front.how: Same as 731: push-ups from the front.

pu-tf-crush-side.how: 6 fps zoomed sheet. Fast close-grip push-ups with the hands on a kettlebell, from the side: chest down to the kettlebell, straight body line. Good form (the fast descent is a tempo tip, not a fault).

sp-mixkit-42899-front.how: 3 fps sheet. Light dumbbells, standing, camera low and looking up. Two full presses from the shoulders to lockout and back; a third reaches the top as the clip ends.

sp-cdc-seated-wide.how: 1 fps sheet. Seated; one press at the end of the shot, cut before it comes down: nothing complete to count.

sp-cdc-seated-close.how: 3 fps sheet. Seated, head to chest in the picture (hips not seen). The shot opens at the top; two full presses rack-top-rack follow; the last one is cut at the top. Good form.

sp-army-pushpress-front.how: 1 and 3 fps sheets. Kettlebell push press (a small knee dip), standing, whole body. The first two shots hold the rack or the top; one complete press in the third shot.

sp-colossus-45-close.how: 3 fps sheet. Seated, camera about 45 degrees, head to chest. Three full presses: good form.

sp-colossus-partial-45.how: 3 fps sheet. The source's 'common mistake' part (a red cross on screen): partial presses that come down only to about ear level and do not lock out. The source does not say which fault it shows; every repetition the coach counts must be judged not clean, and the coach must say to lower to the shoulders. Real wrong-form evidence.

ln-mixkit-52110-side.how: 2 fps zoomed sheet. Reverse lunges holding dumbbells, from the side, alternating legs; each one deep (back knee close to the floor, front thigh about level): good form. The clip ends at the bottom of a sixth lunge (not labelled). A slight forward lean with the dumbbells (the torso tip may show; tips are not false alarms).

ln-mixkit-42898-45.how: 2 fps sheet and the trace. Reverse lunges at about 45 degrees in a living room, hands at the chest, always the same front leg; deep, upright: good form.

ln-mixkit-52112-45.how: 4 fps sheet. Alternating lunges flowing from one into the next without standing fully (the back leg comes through bent), camera between the side and 45 degrees; deep: good form. The clip opens and ends at the bottom of a lunge (not labelled).

ln-mixkit-42900-front.how: 2 fps zoomed sheet. Reverse lunges filmed from the FRONT with ankle weights (one deep lunge 3-6.5 s, one at the start). From the front the two legs lie one behind the other: lunges are set up from the side or at an angle, so the guide asks to turn and nothing is counted, on purpose (on this clip the model read the deep lunge as a quarter lunge on both legs).

ln-army-forward-front.how: 1 and 2 fps sheets. Forward lunges with two kettlebells, the front-facing shots of the source (four windows). Lunges are set up from the side or at an angle: from the front nothing is counted, on purpose.

ln-army-forward-side.how: 2 fps sheets of the three side-view shots (source 32.5-37.6, 43.3-52.2, 58.7-62.6 s; close framing, the head is cut off). Slow forward lunges with kettlebells, back knee to the floor: good form. Labelled: the lunge of shot 1, the second lunge of shot 2 and the lunge of shot 3; the first lunge of shot 2 opens at the bottom (no start position seen). Shot 2 ends at 52.2 s: in its last half second, before the cut, the model's landmarks break up. In this framing the model lays the far leg over the near one at the bottom, so the coach counts these lunges but does not judge them (no rule result either way).

jl-mixkit-52316-45.how: 5 fps zoomed sheet and the trace. Lunge, then a jump with a knee drive, then the next lunge on the same front leg, camera between the side and 45 degrees. Labelled: the four lunges after the first; the first (1.2 s) has no start position before it (the clip opens mid-jump). The knee drives between the lunges must not count (a thigh comes up level there too, on a straight standing leg). Good form.

cs-tf-cossack-front.how: 1 fps zoomed sheets and the trace. Cossack squats with a kettlebell overhead on a beach, facing the camera: five to one side (shot 1), five to the other (shot 2, source 35-67.9 s); slow and deep, staying half-bent between repetitions. Count only (no form rule offered).

ps-single-leg-side.how: 3 fps sheet and the trace. Single-leg squats from the side on grass, the free foot held up behind, a forward lean; the person is small in the picture. The clip opens at the bottom of a first one (not labelled). Count only.

jj-jb-front.how: 6 fps zoomed sheet. Jumping jacks facing the camera (source 0-3.0 and 10.2-13.4 s): the hands meet over the head with the elbows bent, feet wide: good form (SPEC: wrists above the nose).

bp-jb-front.how: 2 fps sheet. Burpees facing the camera (source 2.8-10.2 and 13.2-21.0 s; cut from tests/traces/video/jacks-burpees-21s). Burpees are set up from the side (the plank runs into the depth of the picture from the front): nothing is counted, on purpose.

sq-tf-racked-side.how: 0.5 and 2 fps sheets. Kettlebell racked squats from the side, backlit, deep: good form. At 1-3 s he bends over to pick the kettlebell up (a hinge with bent knees, not a squat): it must not be counted; at the end he puts it down (cut before it ends).

kp-cdc-knee-45.how: Same clip and labels as pu-cdc-knee-45, measured with the kneePushUp move (it is the same movement with a variant of the rules). 2.5 fps sheet. Knee push-ups, camera about 20-35 degrees off the side. The hips look slightly bent; by eye we cannot say whether that is a fault, so the body-line rule is not judged on this clip (neither a false alarm nor a catch).

gs-tf-goblet-front.how: Same clip and labels as sq-tf-goblet-front, measured with the gobletSquat move (it is the same movement with a variant of the rules). 1.7 fps sheet. Kettlebell goblet squats on a beach, facing the camera, bright sun. Two full squats with long pauses standing: good form.

gs-mixkit-52106-front.how: Same clip and labels as sq-mixkit-52106-front, measured with the gobletSquat move (it is the same movement with a variant of the rules). Bottoms read from a 2 fps contact sheet. Goblet squats, thighs about level, knees over the feet: good form.

dl-mixkit-52110-side.how: Same clip and labels as ln-mixkit-52110-side, measured with the dbLunge move (it is the same movement with a variant of the rules). 2 fps zoomed sheet. Reverse lunges holding dumbbells, from the side, alternating legs; each one deep (back knee close to the floor, front thigh about level): good form. The clip ends at the bottom of a sixth lunge (not labelled). A slight forward lean with the dumbbells (the torso tip may show; tips are not false alarms).

pp-army-pushpress-front.how: Same clip and labels as sp-army-pushpress-front, measured with the pushPress move (it is the same movement with a variant of the rules). 1 and 3 fps sheets. Kettlebell push press (a small knee dip), standing, whole body. The first two shots hold the rack or the top; one complete press in the third shot.
